Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and a couple of clarifying questions so we can tailor the PoC: 

Summary from our side:
- Primary goal: evaluate inference latency and cost for your document-search chat feature.
- Expected peak: ~250 concurrent users during batch processing windows, ~50 sustained QPS for conversational endpoint.
- Data: sensitive customer PII; retention policy = 90 days; must meet ACME internal controls.

Clarifying questions:
1) Deployment mode preference: are you evaluating Hosted API first, or do you need Dedicated capacity / Private VPC for data isolation from day 1?
2) Success criteria for PoC (latency, accuracy, cost): do you have hard SLAs we should plan to validate?
3) Stakeholders: can you confirm security/compliance contact and platform owner?

Proposed next step: I can put together a short PoC plan showing timelines for a 3-week trial comparing Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC (if needed), with clear success metrics and required inputs from your side. Hi Ben —

Great recap, thanks. A few notes from our side: 
- Deployment preference: security has flagged that Dedicated capacity or Private VPC will likely be required for production due to PII and our audit requirements. For the PoC, security wants to see both isolation and evidence that Hosted can be locked down (tokenization/masking) before considering Hosted for non-prod.
- Success criteria (what security and infra will measure):
  - End-to-end 95th percentile latency < 300ms for short queries (<= 256 tokens)
  - Embedding generation throughput >= 200/s for batching jobs during nightly indexing
  - No logs or data exfiltration to third-party services; ability to demonstrate audit logs and key management
- Stakeholders: Security lead is Michael Tan (m.tan@acme-corp.com). Platform owner is Priya Desai (copying in next email).

We'd be interested in the PoC plan that compares Hosted vs Dedicated on the metrics above and outlines what we need to provide. 3 weeks sounds reasonable.

Thanks,
Alice
Senior Product Manager, Search
Acme Corp

Subject: Proposed 3-week PoC plan: Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private VPC (details + success criteria)

Hi Alice / Ben —

Thanks for the context — below is a proposed PoC plan to validate deployment modes against ACME's requirements. Happy to jump on a 30-min call to walk through.

High-level goals:
- Validate latency (95p), embedding throughput, and security controls across Hosted, Dedicated, and Private VPC variants.
- Provide evidence artifacts for security (audit logs, KMS usage, network topology diagram).

PoC duration: 3 weeks (target start: 2026-07-08)

Week 0 (kickoff & prep, 3 business days):
- Kickoff call with stakeholders: Product (Alice), Security (Michael), Platform (Priya), Redwood SE (Marissa), AE (Ben).
- Deliverables: PoC SOW and checklist; shared Drive folder; test dataset sample (PII masked) provided by Acme.

Week 1 (Baseline - Hosted API):
- Redwood provides Hosted API test endpoints and a baseline configuration.
- Run latency & throughput tests using Acme's sample workload; run embedding batch job.
- Deliverables: latency/throughput report; example audit logs; any config notes.

Week 2 (Dedicated capacity):
- Provision Dedicated GPU pool for Acme (isolated tenant); migrate test workload.
- Validate throughput and compare per-token cost estimates vs Hosted.
- Deliverables: Dedicated perf/cost report; KV/prefix cache behavior notes.

Week 3 (Private VPC - optional if required by security):
- Spin up Private VPC deployment (customer-managed networking) or run a network isolation test with Acme infra team.
- Validate KMS/HSM integration and audit log ingestion.
- Deliverables: Security evidence pack; network diagrams; final comparison table.

Success criteria (pass/fail signals):
- Performance: 95th percentile latency < 300ms (<=256 tokens) AND embedding throughput >= 200/s (where applicable).
- Security: demonstration of audit logs, KMS key usage, and egress controls for Private VPC / Dedicated.
- Cost: Dedicated per-token cost within 1.5x Hosted baseline for production-ready throughput, or a clear ROI path.

Stakeholders (needed for signoff):
- ACME: Alice Zhou (Product), Michael Tan (Security), Priya Desai (Platform).
- Redwood: Ben Carter (AE), Marissa Cole (SE), Jordan Blake (Sales Engineering Manager).

Required inputs from Acme to start:
- Small sample of representative queries and a 24-hour production trace (if available) — PII masked.
- Test accounts and IP allowlist for Dedicated/Private VPC testing.
- Indication of which model families you want to test (we recommend one LLM for chat + embedding model).

Evidence we will provide for security:
- Audit log exports for all requests during the PoC.
- KMS integration verification checklist and screenshots.
- Short runbook describing network and data flows.

Attachments: Acme_PoC_Checklist.xlsx (checklist), Redwood_PoC_SLA_and_SOW.pdf (SOW template)

Next steps:
1) Alice/Michael: confirm the kickoff attendees and availability for 2026-07-08 week.
2) Acme: share masked sample dataset and test account details by EOD 2026-07-06.
3) Redwood: we'll provision Hosted endpoints and share test harness (k6 + python scripts).

Happy to review on a quick call — let me know availability.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodai.com
